title_en: I Dreamed a Dream, My Love
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'Ми заврна' is rendered 'poured on me' (my reading).

lines.cyr: Сон сонував, либе ле, сон сонував,
lines.lat: Son sonuvav, libe le, son sonuvav,
lines.en: I dreamed a dream, my love, I dreamed a dream,

lines.cyr: сон за мене, либе ле, сон за тебе.
lines.lat: son za mene, libe le, son za tebe.
lines.en: a dream about me, my love, a dream about you.

lines.cyr: Сме станале, либе ле, два галаба,
lines.lat: Sme stanale, libe le, dva galaba,
lines.en: We turned into, my love, two doves,
we flew away, my love, up high,

lines.cyr: на високо, либе ле, на широко.
lines.lat: na visoko, libe le, na široko.
lines.en: up high, my love, far and wide.

lines.cyr: Си летавме, либе ле, низ ливада,
lines.lat: Si letavme, libe le, niz livada,
lines.en: We flew, my love, over a meadow,

lines.cyr: кај што цутат, либе ле, цвеќињата,
lines.lat: kaj što cutat, libe le, cveḱinjata,
lines.en: where, my love, the flowers bloom,
where, my love, the children play.

lines.cyr: Се зададе, либе ле, темен облак,
lines.lat: Se zadade, libe le, temen oblak,
lines.en: A dark cloud came up, my love,

lines.cyr: ми заврна, либе ле, ситен дождец.
lines.lat: mi zavrna, libe le, siten doždec.
lines.en: fine rain poured on me, my love.

lines.cyr: Ми дотече, либе ле, силен порој,
lines.lat: Mi doteče, libe le, silen poroj,
lines.en: A strong torrent came to me, my love,

lines.cyr: ми дотече, либе ле, матен Вардар,
lines.lat: mi doteče, libe le, maten Vardar,
lines.en: muddy Vardar came to me, my love,

lines.cyr: ние двајцата, либе ле, си летнавме,
lines.lat: nie dvajcata, libe le, si letnavme,
lines.en: we two, my love, flew away,
we flew away, my love, we escaped.
